fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-08-07 states that a group of persons allegedly attacked the complainant at Poongodi Layout Residential Colony in Tiruppur, causing injuries that required treatment, on 2025-08-07 at approximately 18:15. A person named Janani Devi, associated with the number 9000000454, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Dinesh Subramani (9000000212) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs and a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00097, as the mobile number 9000000454 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Several persons reportedly attacked the victim in a secluded stretch.
